The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-stolendatatapes_ai-2021-02-18.png]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded 18 February 2021<ref name="img-stolendatatapes_ai91ca80c">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/stolendatatapes_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 commit 91ca80c] (18 February 2021); the PC no longer serves it (the next day the PC moved this PNG to the repository's “hires” folder and published a GIF made from it).
